fields.statement: At 7c67207e I built rhiza with go build into a scratch dir and drove it by hand in scratch repos (RHIZA_* unset, fake rex on PATH). A shape workflow (land -> wait-main -> close-out) run stopped at wait-main; I set its journal workflow to ship-change, ran rhiza land (change set landed), dropped the stopped entry and appended a dead-pid process. The merge-base binary's rhiza run resume --foreground refused it (exit 3, 'is landed, no longer accepted', next rhiza run abandon). The built binary resumed it: wait-main continuing visit 1, pass, close-out ran (wrote its file), 'Run ... succeeded', exit 0. A separate ship-change run on a landed change set whose journal only entered build was still refused with exit 3 naming rhiza run abandon, journal unchanged at 3 lines.

At 7c67207e I built rhiza with go build into a scratch dir and drove it by hand in scratch repos (RHIZA_* unset, fake rex on PATH). On the same interrupted ship-change run past land on a landed change set, rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual --once printed 'Resumed run <id>', journaled one daemon-resumed entry and spawned a real detached rhiza run resume --foreground, which went on past wait-main through close-out to a finished/succeeded entry with no 'no longer accepted' refusal. A second --once --json gave resumed: []. In another repo, --once resumed none of: a landed run that never entered land, a landed run already daemon-resumed and interrupted again, and a failed run after land.

At 7c67207e I built rhiza with go build into a scratch dir and drove it by hand in scratch repos (RHIZA_* unset, fake rex on PATH). rhiza inbox on the interrupted ship-change run past land on a landed change set printed 'Nothing waits on you' (the merge-base binary listed it as skipped with rhiza run abandon). In a repo with three landed change sets and fixture journals, rhiza inbox listed exactly: skipped run N-LAND (never reached land) with next rhiza run abandon N-LAND, failed run F-LAND (main-green failed after land) with next rhiza run resume --retry, and gave-up run G-LAND (entered land, daemon-resumed, interrupted again) with next rhiza run resume G-LAND.
